description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Join our Pricing Team in Mexico, where you'll optimize prices to boost key metrics and enhance user experience. You'll develop playbooks, frameworks, and tools while collaborating with operations teams to execute impactful strategies. This role is perfect for someone passionate about influencing business outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

In this role, you'll be...


Work on the region’s pricing strategy;
Create frameworks to improve decision-making;
Analyze data to understand user behavior, generating actionable insights;
Develop methodologies to optimize pricing decisions;
Collaborate with different areas like operations, marketing, product, and growth



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in engineering, economics, business, data science, or a related field.

Skills: Proficiency in Excel and SQL; strong communication and stakeholder management; analytical problem-solving with strategic thinking; data-driven decision-making.

Work Style: Adaptable and proactive, thriving in ambiguous environments; hands-on approach to experimenting and executing projects.

Languages: Professional proficiency in English and Spanish.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

title: Senior Web Growth Lead
description:
🌎 Fully remote (LATAM or North America time zones, within 3 hours of Mexico City)

🏆 Strong communication skills in English

💼 Full-time senior level role




About Meaningful




Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.




About us: www.m8l.com




Our leadership brings serious Silicon Valley and LATAM experience:

• CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)

• CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world

• Ali Abdala, Web Growth Director: Former Acquisition Director at Konfío, a Mexican unicorn. At Meaningful, she leads the web growth team, connecting strategy, experimentation and execution to improve digital acquisition.




We're intentionally small: a 50+ person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:

• Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com

• Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com

• Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest

• Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups




About the role




We’re looking for a senior web growth professional with strong expertise in product marketing, web strategy, user experience, messaging and copy.




Your goal will be to grow digital acquisition through the website. You’ll lead the strategy and experimentation behind that growth, identifying opportunities to create clearer, more effective experiences for the people we want to reach.




This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll bring a clear point of view on how the website can drive those results, then bring it to life by shaping page structures, developing messaging and writing copy. As an individual contributor, you’ll collaborate with a team that includes designers and CRO specialists, using AI tools to support your work.




What you will own




• Business and web strategy. Translate business goals and customer understanding into a focused strategy for the website. Identify the most valuable opportunities and help the team decide what to prioritize and why.

• Product positioning and messaging. Understand the audience, the offer and its differentiation. Develop messaging that makes the value clear and gives people a reason to take the next step.

• User experience and creative quality. Bring creativity and a discerning eye to user flows, page narratives and content quality. Partner with designers to make the experience clear, engaging and consistent with the brand.

• Page structure and copy. Create page structures and write and refine copy yourself, working with the team to carry the strategic intent through to the finished experience.

• Paid campaign landing pages. Partner with the Paid team to align landing pages with campaign strategy and intent, helping improve the efficiency of acquisition investment.

• Research and web experimentation ideas. Combine customer research, business insights and performance data to frame useful hypotheses. Work with CRO to interpret results and decide what to test or improve next.




What you will bring




• Senior web strategy and growth judgment. You have shaped a website or landing-page strategy around business and customer needs. You can explain how you prioritized opportunities, weighed tradeoffs and evaluated results across acquisition, conversion and lead quality.

• Creative and UX judgment. You recognize what makes a web experience clear, compelling and true to the brand. You give specific, constructive feedback that helps designers do their best work.

• Hands-on web and content experience. You can show examples of page structures, messaging and copy you developed yourself, and explain your contribution and the reasoning behind it.

• AI curiosity and adaptability. You stay current on how AI is reshaping websites and user journeys, and actively apply what you learn to improve both web experiences and the team’s workflows.

• Practical experimentation and analysis skills. You can analyze research, funnel data and business insights to frame useful hypotheses and recognize uncertainty. You do not need to configure experiments or bring advanced statistical expertise; you work with CRO on those specialist areas.

• Senior leadership and collaboration. You can lead web strategy independently, collaborate across disciplines and report results to senior leaders in large organizations.

• Excellent English communication. Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You can present proposals, explain your reasoning and engage in constructive debate with senior stakeholders.




Experience we value




• Product marketing, especially B2B. Experience translating customer and market insight into clear positioning and messaging for complex products or services.

• Relevant industry experience. We value experience in marketplaces, in the restaurant industry, or with products or platforms for merchants.

• Performance marketing. Experience connecting analytical and creative thinking to acquisition results, with an understanding of how campaigns and web experiences work together.

• Startups, tech and established brands. Experience in startups or tech companies, alongside work with established brands or major accounts. We value the ability to adapt to different stages, constraints and ways of working.




We welcome other backgrounds with a strong record in web strategy.




What this looks like in practice




• Take a page from strategy to launch. This is what you’ll spend most of your time doing. Analyze the opportunity, define the page’s strategy and role within the site, and develop its structure, messaging, and copy. Partner with Design and Development, give feedback as the page takes shape, coordinate the launch, and review its performance.

• Align product positioning and messaging across the site. Clarify what makes the product worth choosing and adapt that message to what visitors need to know on each page.

• Build and prioritize the web roadmap. Work with the SEO/AEO and Paid teams to align on quarterly acquisition and conversion goals and how the website can help meet them.

• Develop hypotheses to improve conversion across the site. Partner with the CRO specialists to identify where people get stuck and shape what to test.

• Help shape how the website evolves in the AI era. Stay on top of how AI is changing how people discover and use websites. Turn those insights into experiments and coordinate with the teams that can put what works into practice.




What success looks like




• Client and team alignment: The web strategy reflects the brand and business goals, with a shared understanding of priorities across the client and team.

• A clearer, stronger web presence: The website reflects the brand’s positioning, makes the offer easy to understand and supports visibility in a world of AI-powered discovery.

• Stronger acquisition and conversion: Evidence of progress in web acquisition and conversion on priority journeys, with lead quality considered alongside volume.

• Iteration, learning and evolution: Ongoing experimentation with the CRO, SEO/AEO and Paid teams helps us scale what works across the site and adapt our web strategy as AI continues to change how websites work.

Platicar de 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵 con 𝗻𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗼𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝘀

• Gusto por hablar con dueños de negocio.

• Suma: salir en cámara, CapCut o Edits, Canva, experiencia en tecnología o startups.




𝗟𝗼 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗼𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘀

Administrar y optimizar de manera autónoma el presupuesto de inversión comercial acordado para lograr los objetivos de Sell-Out anual.

Liderar negociaciones directas de alto impacto con compradores y tomadores de decisión comerciales para asegurar visibilidad en banners estratégicos, exclusividades y participación en las mejores temporalidades de pauta (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, Pet Week, etc.).
Diseñar las campañas de Retail Media y de pauta dentro de las aplicaciones de entrega rápida (Rappi Ads, Uber Ads) y plataformas Omnicanal.

Monitorear y evaluar de manera constante el Retorno de la Inversión Publicitaria (ROAS) y la efectividad del gasto (CPS, CPC, CPM), reasignando presupuestos de manera dinámica en función del desempeño.

KAMs Tradicionales: Asegurar una ejecución omnicanal homogénea que elimine fricciones o canibalización entre canales físicos y digitales.

Sell-Out: Cumplimiento y superación de la cuota de venta anual del portafolio digital en Last Milers y TikTok Shop.

Mínimo de 2 a 3 años de experiencia en posiciones de eCommerce, KAM Digital, Trade Marketing Digital o Growth Marketing, preferentemente en empresas de consumo masivo (FMCG) o retail.
Experiencia demostrable en el manejo, análisis y optimización de plataformas de Retail Media (ej. Rappi Ads, Uber Ads, Walmart Connect, etc.).

Dominio avanzado de MS Office (Excel analítico para manejo de bases de datos).
Mentalidad orientada a datos (Data-Driven Decision Making) con facilidad para interpretar números, tendencias y transformarlos en iniciativas de venta.

Adaptabilidad y Resiliencia: Capacidad para navegar en entornos de alta incertidumbre y velocidad que caracterizan al canal digital.
Trabajo en Equipo y Colaboración: Espíritu integrador enfocado en alcanzar metas conjuntas bajo una cultura ágil.
Trabajar con Asociados diversos y talentosos, todos guiados por los Cinco Principios.
Unirte a una empresa con propósito, donde nos esforzamos por construir hoy el mundo que queremos para el mañana.

description:
We’re hiring a Marketing Manager to attract qualified candidates through social media, paid campaigns, and other channels across Latin America.




About Viva Talent




Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.




Why we’re opening this role




We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.




Responsibilities




Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.
Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.
Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.
Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.
Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.
Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead new team members.




Requirements




Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.
Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).
End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.
Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.
AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.
Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.




Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.




Location

Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.




Benefits




100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.
Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.




How we hire




A focused process: application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

description:
About us




We build AI agents for manufacturing. Allie integrates intelligence into factory operations: learning from machines, sensors and systems to detect problems, recommend actions and coordinate responses in real time. Our platform connects to PLCs, MES and ERPs through secure edge gateways. It transforms raw data into operational decisions that improve availability, quality and throughput. We work with large manufacturing groups in the food, beverage and CPG industries deploying AI agents that embed into production lines and scale across sites. Allie is built to act, not just report. From real-time monitoring to autonomous control, we help your factory think and self-optimize.




Sales, rebuilt as an engineering discipline. One operator, one agent stack, the entire revenue machine — for an AI company selling into the factory floor.




FULL-CYCLE · AI-NATIVE · BUILD THE MACHINE, OWN THE NUMBER




01 · THE THESIS




This role didn't exist three years ago




The old playbook — hire SDRs, buy twelve tools, pray the CRM stays clean — is being replaced. In its place: one or two operators who build the machine instead of being the machine.




They map the ICP and TAM programmatically. They watch every named account for signals and react the same day. They run outbound, inbound, events, and deal support as maintained systems, not repeated tasks. They spawn agents that verify their own output and loop until the outcome is achieved. And they do it for a fraction of what the equivalent sales-tool stack costs.




The profile is scarce: full-cycle sales fluency, technical instinct, and AI-native operation rarely live in the same person. This charter exists because Allie runs GTM this way — and is looking for the operator who wants to own it.




02 · THE ROLE




One operator, the entire top-of-funnel




Allie sells an operational copilot to Tier-1 manufacturers. The buyers are plant directors, VPs of operations, and CTOs at global brewers, food producers, and CPG companies — people who don't respond to spray-and-pray. They respond to precision.




This is not an SDR job and not a marketing job. It is one operator running the entire acquisition machine as a system: every list, every signal, every sequence, every call, every event, every piece of reporting — designed, automated, and maintained by you, with Claude Code and a small set of external APIs doing the work a six-person growth team used to do.




You own the number that matters: qualified hand-offs to technical sales. Everything below exists to feed it.




03 · WHAT YOU OWN




Six systems, one owner




SYS 01 · ICP & data foundation

Map the full ICP and TAM: the named-account universe for brewing, food & bev, and CPG manufacturing across US, Mexico, and LATAM
Build signal-based and lookalike lists off closed-won accounts; refresh continuously, not quarterly
Track every champion who changes jobs and route them as a new account
Own CRM architecture and reporting — pipeline truth lives here, and it is your truth to keep clean



SYS 02 · Signals & real-time reaction

Watch named accounts for tech-stack changes, funding, layoffs, headcount swings, new plant announcements, and expansion CapEx — and react the same day
De-anonymize website traffic, score it against closed-won, and push qualified visitors into sequence



SYS 03 · Outbound engine

Set up and maintain the mail infrastructure — domains, warm-up, deliverability
Build and run multi-touch sequences across email and LinkedIn
Build the cold-calling engine: parallel dialing at scale — calls running back-to-back with no dead time, the next account queued while the current call is live, every outcome written straight into CRM. Calling is a throughput problem, and you engineer the throughput
Score every inbound against past closed-won and auto-route qualified leads to technical sales
Re-engage closed-lost on a systematic cadence



SYS 04 · Inbound & content

Build the inbound system end to end: content filtered for the ICP, distributed across LinkedIn, amplified through a creator/operator network
Own content management and the publishing cadence — a visible calendar, a pipeline from draft to published, a rhythm that doesn't skip weeks
Run focused AEO efforts so Allie is the answer when a plant director asks an AI "how do I cut unplanned downtime"



SYS 05 · Events — an owned motion, not a side project

Own the event calendar for the ICP — several shows are already locked for this year; you run those end to end and build the calendar forward from what they produce
Pre-event: named-account target list per show, booking sequences 4–6 weeks out, meetings landed before the doors open — a booth with no calendar is a cost center
On-site: every conversation captured into CRM same-day with context, not badge scans
Post-event: 100% of captured contacts in sequence within 48 hours; qualified ones handed off within a week
Report pipeline generated per event and kill the events that don't pay for themselves



SYS 06 · Deal support & feedback loops

Auto-build a pre-call brief for every meeting on the calendar
Generate the one-pager, ROI model, and proposal inputs per deal
Analyze sales calls and feed patterns back into sequences, content, and qualification criteria
Manage the sales collateral library — decks, one-pagers, case studies — versioned, current, and findable, so no one ever ships a stale asset



04 · HOW YOU WORK




Local-first. Agent-native. Human judgment on every send.




You build local-first. Every workflow starts on your own machine with Claude Code — no platform dependency, no waiting on anyone else's roadmap. If a workflow needs a platform to exist, it doesn't exist yet. As workflows prove out, they migrate into Rooster, Allie's internal GTM agent, so the engine becomes a company asset, not a laptop. Local Claude Code is where you build; Rooster is where it lands.




Every workflow is a system you build once and maintain, not a task you repeat. You spawn subagents that verify their own output, you loop until the outcome is achieved, and you treat "I did it manually" as a bug report against your own tooling.




Nothing client-facing auto-sends. You review and approve every external touch. Automation buys you volume; judgment is still the job.




05 · WHO YOU ARE




Three non-negotiables

TRAITWHAT IT MEANS HEREFull-cycle sales fluencyYou understand the whole cycle — prospecting through close through expansion. You've carried a number, or sat close enough to one to feel it.Technical by instinctYou can read an API doc, reason about a data model, and debug your own workflow at 11pm before a launch. You may not call yourself an engineer; you build like one.Al-native operationYou run AI as an operating discipline — agents that verify their output, loops that run until the outcome is achieved, workflows that cost a fraction of the equivalent SaaS stack.




Strong signals: you've built a growth system solo that a team later inherited; you've sold into manufacturing, industrial, or another long-cycle technical buyer; you've worked an event circuit and can show pipeline per show, not photos of the booth.




06 · THE FIRST 30 DAYS




The engine gets built. All of it.




Not phased, not sequenced, not "foundations first." By day 30, every system above is live: ICP universe in CRM, signal watching running, mail infrastructure warm and sequences shipping, the calling engine dialing, inbound pipeline producing, event calendar locked with meetings booked, pre-call briefs generating for every calendar meeting. Built locally with Claude Code, migrating into Rooster as each workflow proves out.




From day 31, the conversation is results. The measurement framework already exists — a weekly growth scorecard, built and run by the CRO, with qualified hand-offs and closes as the north star. You don't design the measurement system; you feed it.




07 · WHERE THIS GOES




The machine you build becomes the org you run




This role grows into technical sales leadership: managing both the growth function and the technical-sales AEs who carry deals from demo to close. The path is direct — first you build the acquisition machine, then you own the people and the machine together.




Most companies split this work across six tools and four people. Here it is one operator, one agent stack, and full ownership — and the ceiling on the role is whatever you make the machine capable of.

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Manager, Marketing Data and Technology to own the reliability of the data and technical processes that support Oportun’s marketing ecosystem. You’ll ensure marketing data is accurate, complete, consistent, and available across platforms and internal systems to support campaign execution, measurement, attribution, and growth.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You’ll serve as the primary owner for assigned MarTech systems, integrations, and tracking processes, working independently to identify issues, recommend solutions, and drive improvements through implementation. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and external vendors to keep systems reliable and data flowing correctly.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

You’ll own marketing data quality across assigned platforms and internal databases, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely delivery.
You’ll build and maintain validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting processes to identify missing records, discrepancies, and failed data flows.
You’ll investigate root causes of data and integration issues and drive solutions through implementation and ongoing monitoring.
You’ll manage website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics, tag management configurations, pixels, and event implementations.
You’ll configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and data integrations between marketing vendors and internal systems.
You’ll use Python or SQL to query, validate, transform, and reconcile data and automate recurring operational tasks.
You’ll manage and troubleshoot assigned MarTech tools and configurations to support reliable data collection, audience activation, and reporting.
You’ll establish and maintain consistent UTM parameters, campaign naming conventions, and tracking standards to improve attribution and measurement.
You’ll identify data gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities to improve tracking, integrations, automation, and operational efficiency.
You’ll document data flows, tracking definitions, configurations, validation procedures, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity and reliable operations.
You’ll coordinate with cross-functional partners and vendors on requirements, testing, releases, issue resolution, priorities, and risks.
You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on technical marketer who enjoys solving data and systems problems and taking ownership from issue identification through resolution. You’re comfortable working independently, but you also know when to bring in the right partners.

You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and process-minded. You care about data quality, clear documentation, and reliable systems, and you consistently look for ways to make technical workflows more scalable and efficient.

What You Bring

Required

Skills & experience

5+ years of relevant experience in marketing technology, marketing data operations, data engineering, marketing analytics, or a similar technical role.
Proficiency in Python or SQL, with the ability to independently write, troubleshoot, and maintain code for data validation, transformation, or automation.

Experience reconciling data across systems, implementing quality checks, and resolving underlying data issues.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on implementation.
Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and project management skills.
Ability to work autonomously across teams, vendors, and time zones while managing competing priorities.

Nice to Have

Experience establishing or maintaining website and digital tagging frameworks and marketing attribution data.
Experience with Databricks, customer data platforms, Amplitude, Iterable, or similar marketing and analytics tools.
Experience with scripting, workflow automation, scheduled data jobs, or monitoring tools.
Experience in financial services or another environment involving sensitive customer data.
Familiarity with data privacy, access controls, and governance requirements.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, or automation.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI Isn't a Feature Here. It's How We Work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's In It For You

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

description:
About The Team

Studio Z, Zillow's in-house creative agency, is seeking a versatile writer and strategist to expand our Content team's capabilities. We develop engaging content that helps consumers and real estate professionals achieve their goals — from in-depth articles to snappy email copy to video scripts and social posts. We embody the Zillow core values of transparency, integrity, and putting customers first. To thrive here, you'll also need a good dose of empathy and a sense of humor.

About The Role

This role will craft accurate, compelling content across a wide range of formats: longform articles, shortform web and email copy, and video scripts — both short product showcase videos and longer educational pieces. You'll serve as a thought partner to your Marketing colleagues, helping shape how content can best support our audiences and business goals. Then, working with designers and other creatives, you'll bring your ideas to life as polished, brand-aligned assets. Whatever the format, your sharp, thoughtful writing will inform, engage, and inspire our audiences to work with Zillow.

Because this role is based in Mexico and serves a US-based audience, it requires exceptional English writing and speaking ability — the kind that comes naturally and produces polished, publication-ready copy without heavy editing. Native or near-native fluency is required.

You'll get to:


Work across a wide range of content formats — articles, emails, social posts, web copy, and video scripts — to tell stories that resonate with Zillow's consumer and professional audiences. 
Partner with Marketing colleagues to understand strategic goals and advise on how content can best support them. 
Go deep into content creation, collaborating with a versatile Studio team to produce high-quality pieces at a range of lengths and formats. 
Build understanding and empathy for the challenges facing Americans who are looking to buy, sell, and rent homes in a complex market — and for the hard-working industry professionals who support them. 
Draw on internal research, expert interviews, and external sources to bring stories to life. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

Who you are:


A versatile content creator who can move fluidly between longform editorial, tight email and web copy, and engaging video scripts. 
A curious, diligent writer who can learn the nuances of Zillow's products and services and distill them into clear, compelling stories. 
A strategic problem solver who understands content performance metrics and insights, and use them to optimize your work and communicate its value. 
A meticulous editor who can serve as the last set of eyes on a piece before it’s published. 
A kind, fun colleague who enjoys collaborating with other creatives and learning new things while making work we can all be proud of.. 


Qualifications:


Minimum of 5 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience. 
Native or near-native English fluency required. This role demands a true command of written and spoken English — candidates should be exceptional writers who can produce polished, publication-ready content across formats without heavy editing support. 
Demonstrated expertise creating content across multiple formats (articles, email copy, video scripts, web copy, etc.). 
Ability to produce high-quality work efficiently and adapt quickly to shifting priorities. 
Real estate knowledge is a plus but not required. 


We will consider candidates of all backgrounds who bring experience with the core duties and an eagerness to help our audiences succeed.

While this is a remote role, it will require some travel for in-person gatherings and work sessions.

To apply, please submit an application with your resume and a portfolio of copywriting work samples. Applications without work samples will not be considered.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

description:
Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote




The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

1. Background in AI, machine learning, computer science, or another technical field.

2. Experience at an AI lab, AI-native company, research organization, developer-focused company, or highly technical startup.

3. Experience working directly with research teams and technical leadership.

4. Familiarity with academic publishing, AI benchmarks, evaluations, citations, and research dissemination.

5. Experience launching technical content or research that achieved meaningful adoption, citations, community engagement, or industry impact.

Role Title: Product Marketing Reviewer (Remote)
Role Type: Contractor

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.




How It Works

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.




Who This Is For

We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.

About Delinea

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Technical Account Manager 

This position is hyrbid in Mexico City (Tue, Wed, Thur) at our office in Reforma. 

Position Summary

80% of breaches involve privileged credential misuse. Delinea, the leader in Cloud-Ready Privilege Access Management is ready to help minimize the potential attack surface. As such, we are seeking an experienced and self- driven Technical Account Manager to join our outstanding Customer Success team. If you are well versed in and have a passion for Privilege Access Management, Cyber Security, Infrastructure and Identity Security, and experience working with Enterprise customers in a technical trusted advisory role, you might have what it takes to become a Delinea Technical Account Manager. This individual will need to be detail oriented, proactive, and able to perform well under pressure. If you are motivated by challenges, have a passion for excellence, and are customer-centric then this could be the opportunity for you. Accountability, motivation, creativity, and tenacity are the key success attributes for this role.

What You’ll Do


 Serve as a technical subject matter expert for Delinea’s Privilege Access services and product offerings
 Be the customer trusted advisor to ensure engagement and success with the Delinea solution deployment, expedite resolutions to obstacles, and help them derive the most out of their Delinea investment.
 Regularly monitor customer health, and communicate results with regional sales team, support, and renewals team
 Deliver remote services to new and existing customers including software configuration, onboarding, and training
 Engage with customers to quickly resolve high priority issues impacting their service delivery
 Track new bugs, new product releases, and security vulnerabilities and proactively notify customer of any changes that may impact its


environments. Will serve as the customer advocate for promoting customer interest within Delinea Engineering and Product Management organizations for future functionality and product roadmap items.


 Regular review sessions to validate plans, configurations, and designs


centered around Delinea software and operations.


 Document customer environment details and share with Delinea


Support and Engineering teams for faster issue root-cause and resolution.


 Coordinate and oversee Early Beta Access program of new releases,


identifying opportunities to impact future product direction and assist with the testing and validation process


 Subject to travel and safety restrictions, travel to customer facilities


primarily in North America for Quarterly Business Reviews and Solution assessment.


 Maintain an established level of performance with our customers measured via satisfaction surveys
 Foster and leverage key relationships inside Delinea to influence various functional groups to apply key resources to solve customer issues quickly.
 Develop and present executive-facing reports that summarize real- time situational updates and analysis as well as key themes extracted from escalations worldwide.


What You’ll Bring


 4+ years of experience in a similar role as a Customer Success Manager, Helpdesk Manager, Support Engineer, Professional Services Consultant or Sales Engineer
 Understanding of applications, infrastructure and processes used in large organizations that are typically integrated with Privilege Access Management solutions
 Previous experience with Delinea or with other Privilege Access Service solutions such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, etc. is a big plus
 Experience leading large, transformational technology projects that cross typical enterprise silos
 Experience addressing significant technical challenges with minimal supervision or guidance.
 Proven ability to plan, organize, and prioritize multiple projects and responsibilities on a weekly basis.
 Comfortable interfacing directly with complex, multi-divisional, multi- geographical clients, preferably at the director level
 Demonstrated ability to quickly and proficiently understand and absorb new information.
 Prior success delivering objectives in a consistent and professional manner through both expected and unforeseen challenges.
 Must have demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills in a professional setting with an ability to articulate complex operations to technical audiences.
 Must be able to construct documentation that identifies current and established operational procedures, and proposed modifications and changes in a clear and concise manner is imperative.


Technical Competencies


 Microsoft Active Directory administration and design experience
 Microsoft Windows server administration and engineering experience
 Expertise with at least one major Infrastructure as a Services (IaaS)


provider such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon.


 Must have UNIX and/or Linux administration experience in large organizations.
 Experience with NIS, or LDAP administration is a plus.
 Previous experience working with cloud or as-a-service solutions
 Strong compliance knowledge (PCI, SOX, GLBA, etc.) as related to


infrastructure security and access management


 Should have a working knowledge of UNIX authentication and


authorization management, PAM, NSS & Kerberos


 Experience with other PAS solutions such as BeyondTrust, CyberArk, etc.
 Demonstrated capabilities with scripting languages such as perl and PowerShell
 Network Storage Device Administration experience is a plus
 Microsoft SQL Reporting Services experience is a plus
 Experience with Microsoft Clustering Services (MCS) is a plus
 Experience with RabbitMQ or message brokering is a plus


Why work at Delinea? 


We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.


At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:


Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team
Ownership - We take initiative and follow through
Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment
Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes


We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

description:
Traild: Who are we?  
Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

About
Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role
As Traild accelerates its expansion across North America, we are looking for an Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to own the full implementation journey for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise clients. This is a newly dedicated enterprise-focused role, created because enterprise implementations demand a different level of rigor, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination than mid-market work. You will sit within the Customer Success team and collaborate daily with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product to get clients live and, more importantly, to ensure they adopt Traild in a way that delivers lasting value.

Key Responsibilities


Drive enterprise implementations ($100K+ ACV) from scoping through to go-live and beyond, maintaining momentum across long and complex project timelines with multiple concurrent accounts
Own the end-to-end client journey from onboarding through to successful adoption, ensuring customers achieve measurable value
Provide user training, technical support and troubleshooting throughout implementation and beyond
Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product daily to work through client-specific issues, surface product feedback and keep implementations moving without unnecessary delays
Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders and decision-makers, managing expectations clearly and maintaining CSAT above 90% across your portfolio
Own your personal KPIs including go-live targets, adoption outcomes and client health metrics, and contribute actively to internal documentation and process improvement
Drive momentum in complex or ambiguous customer environments, keeping implementations on track without needing to escalate




Who You Are
You are an experienced implementation professional who has worked directly with enterprise clients in a B2B SaaS environment and knows what it takes to get complex projects across the line without losing sight of the longer-term adoption outcome. You bring a confident, consultative approach and thrive in fast-moving environments where you need to problem-solve, prioritize and own your outcomes with limited hand-holding.

Must have


Advanced English proficiency (CEFR C1 or equivalent) — both written and spoken
Strong project management skills — owning scoping, timelines, risk management and driving outcomes independently
Solid technical aptitude, comfortable working across integrations, workflows, and partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with senior and executive-level stakeholders
Comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are still being built and the pace of change is high
Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit




Nice to have


5–7 years of direct enterprise-level implementation experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong preference for AP, accounting or fintech software
Familiarity with ERP or payment related platforms, particularly IFS, Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1 or SYSPRO




We know great implementation people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Location & Language Requirements 
This role is open exclusively to candidates based in Canada, Mexico or Colombia. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in the United States at this time.

Given the global nature of our business and the customers you'll be supporting, candidates must demonstrate advanced English language proficiency (CEFR C1 level or above), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Salary Range
The base salary range for this position is:



Canada: $90,000–$110,000 CAD per year
Mexico and Colombia: Competitive, market-aligned compensation based on local salary benchmarks




Compensation is determined based on experience, education and geographic location. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s qualifications and prevailing market conditions in their location.

The Perks of Working at Traild



Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options.  
Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world.  
We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it  
Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 62, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

title: Account & Performance Manager
skills: Mapear y mantener el ciclo mensual de Performance semana a semana: qué proceso corre, quién participa, con qué herramienta y qué entregable sale.

Documentar la operación diaria por rol (Customer Success, Dirección de Marca, Comunidad Comercial, Público Comercial) y las metodologías por tipo de cliente: onboarding, integración de plataformas y CRM.
Sostener Asana como fuente de verdad del ciclo y Drive como repositorio del sistema — nada vive solo en la cabeza de una persona.

Correr los gates del mes: preps de Público, Comunidad y Dirección de Marca a tiempo, estrategias listas para validación antes de llegar al cliente, y cierre con retrabajo, incidentes y capacidad del mes siguiente.
Co-diseñar con el Performance Results Manager la metodología de crecimiento por tipo de cliente: PRM aporta el qué, tú lo conviertes en proceso.
Mantener el modelo de capacidad por rol y asignar cuentas con base en él, no en quién parece tener espacio.
Frenar o repriorizar la entrada de clientes cuando no hay capacidad financiada, con la decisión documentada.
Proponer al CEO las necesidades de contratación con datos de capacidad — tu modelo es el insumo del plan de reclutamiento.
Conducir la evaluación técnica y operativa de los candidatos a los roles de tu área.
Liderar de forma directa a Customer Success, Dirección de Marca y Comunidad Comercial: 1:1 mensuales, feedback y desarrollo conforme al plan de carrera.
Evaluar desempeño y periodos de prueba de tu área junto con HR.
Conducir el onboarding operativo de cada nuevo ingreso del área.
Exigir el ciclo a tiempo y desarrollar a tus CSPO — sin rehacer su estrategia por ellos.
Llevar una cuenta directa, para no perder contacto con la operación real del cliente.
Recibir los escalamientos operativos y de relación de los CSPO — que llegan con propuesta — y decidir el siguiente paso.
Dividir con PRM sin absorber: tú decides si hay capacidad y cómo corre el sistema; PRM decide si el resultado económico se sostiene.
Diseño de procesos, flujos o modelos de capacidad que tu equipo siguió usando sin depender de ti.
Gestión de carga y prioridades con datos: carga por persona, entregables a tiempo y retrabajo.
Documentación operativa: escribes procesos que otros ejecutan sin tener que preguntarte.
Lectura de performance (ROAS, CPA, CVR) suficiente para operar una cuenta y decidir prioridades o recursos con esos números.
Stack real: Asana como sistema del equipo, Slack, Google Workspace, Claude y AgencyAnalytics.
Corriges el proceso, no a la persona: cuando el ciclo se rompe, buscas el cuello de botella antes que al responsable.
Dices “no” con datos: frenas un cliente nuevo o una prioridad cuando la capacidad no da, y lo sostienes.
Conversaciones difíciles sin evadir: das feedback directo y le das seguimiento hasta que cambia el resultado.
Delegas sin absorber: cuando algo escala, defines qué hace cada rol en lugar de resolverlo tú solo.
4 años en agencia de marketing digital o medios, en operaciones, delivery o account management.
2 años liderando personas de forma directa: 1:1, feedback, evaluaciones y desarrollo.
Experiencia con varias cuentas en agencia, trato directo con clientes y manejo de escalamientos.
Modalidad híbrida con flexibilidad real.
Autoridad real sobre la operación: decides capacidad, asignaciones y cómo corre el ciclo mensual de toda la unidad de Performance.
Un equipo a tu cargo y un sistema en marcha para llevarlo al siguiente nivel — no arrancas de cero.
Contacto directo con el CEO y acceso a herramientas de punta, incluyendo IA aplicada a la operación.
Plan de carrera claro: Performance Operations Manager → Performance Operations Senior Manager conforme Startop escala.
Aplica en LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado.
Responde las preguntas filtro con honestidad — son parte del proceso.
Si hay match, HR te contacta en 72 horas para agendar el primer filtro.
El proceso incluye un caso práctico de capacidad y ciclo mensual, que presentarás antes de la entrevista final.
El proceso completo toma entre 3 y 4 semanas.

Acompañar las activaciones de marca y negociaciones de eventos en la zona asignada, garantizando su correcta ejecución a través de las agencias y operadores involucrados.

title: ABM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




ABM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
VALD is the world leader in technology for the allied health industry, providing innovative human-measurement technology to over 10,000 clients in over 150 countries. If you have a favourite team in the NBA, EPL, or NFL, there's a good chance they use VALD Technologies.




Since its humble beginnings in 2015 in Brisbane, Australia, VALD has grown to a team of over 300 team members in over 35 countries, with 5 offices across four continents.




Driven by a multidisciplinary team of researchers, clinicians, sports scientists, designers, developers and engineers, VALD's suite of systems offer unparalleled insight into human movement, performance, injury risk and rehabilitation. 




About the role 




We’re growing fast and looking for a HubSpot & Automation Specialist to join our global team.

In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things HubSpot, working closely with our sales team, sales operations, IT, and customer success teams to streamline workflows, automate processes, and improve reporting across the business.




You’ll dive deep into our CRM setup, troubleshoot and resolve automation issues, and build scalable solutions that support our team’s productivity. From managing users and teams in HubSpot to integrating with tools like Databricks, NetSuite, and Microsoft 365 - you’ll play a critical role in making our CRM smarter and more efficient.




We’ll support you with the tools and context you need to succeed, but we’re looking for someone who’s proactive, technically capable, and passionate about building better systems.




What you will do




HubSpot Administration -Manage users, teams, permissions, and profiles within HubSpot
Build and maintain ticketing workflows
Review and resolve existing automation issues
Audit and optimize legacy workflows for efficiency and scalability
Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and pages
Develop and maintain integrations with tools such as: Databricks, Microsoft Suite, NetSuite among others
Write and maintain custom code/scripts where needed
Collaborate with IT and internal stakeholders to streamline CRM processes
Provide technical support and training to internal teams
Contribute to the overall CRM framework and strategy across team
Identify opportunities to improve CRM usability, automation, and reporting for all departments and proactively suggest and implement enhancements to workflows




Is this you? 




You are bilingual, with English as your second language, and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proven 2+ years of experience with HubSpot CRM and its automation capabilities
Advanced coding skills 
Hold a degree in Engineering or Business Management
Experience with data tools (Microsoft Suite, Databricks) and ERP systems (NetSuite)
Excellent problem-solving and workflow design skills
Comfortable working cross-functionally with IT, Sales, and Customer Success
Detail-oriented with a passion for clean, scalable systems




It’s not expected that any single candidate would check every box here. If you meet just some of the requirements, but not all, we encourage you to submit your application!




We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re at all interested. Show us how your experience could improve our team and widen our perspective. Our selection process includes assessing the requirements of the role vs the individual, and how well we think they will work in the VALD team.




Why VALD?




The perks of working with us are pretty great! The list is extensive of what we offer when you join VALD, here’s just a few:




The opportunity to work in a company that is redefining allied healthcare.
Learn from a range of high-performing individuals and teams across a range of disciplines.
Be part of a down-to-earth, inclusive and vibrant team.
The latest equipment and remote setup to perform at your best.




VALD Diversity & Inclusion Commitment




VALD’s best asset is not our technology but our people and culture. A culture of inclusion and diversity is critical to our business. We know diverse teams perform better. It's not a separate initiative – we aim to embed inclusion and diversity in everything we do. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and embracing diversity, including gender, nationality, disability, age, marital/parental status, ethnicity, gender identity, socioeconomic background and sexual orientation. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds.




Conditions of Employment




Successful applicants will be subject to background checks (including identity and criminal record checks). It will be a condition of employment that the background checks return acceptable results.

Apply prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop controls to improve solution quality and reliability.

Communicate product decisions, technical concepts, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to both business and technical audiences.

Strong product and problem-discovery skills: ability to understand ambiguous business challenges, identify user needs, define outcomes, and guide a solution from concept to launch and adoption.

Business and GTM understanding, including familiarity with B2B Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or related workflows.

title: Functional Transformation - Senior Consultant
description:
Functional Transformation - Senior Consultant - Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX)

Healthcare & Life Science Senior Consultant

Deloitte's Sales & Service practice partners with the world's leading life sciences companies to reimagine how their commercial, medical, and field organizations operate, and to bring that vision to life on Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud. This role is built for consultants who lead with functional depth. Candidates should have actually run, designed, or advised on processes like Key Account Management, Speaker and Event Management, Field Coaching, or Medical Interaction workflows, and be able to translate that operating knowledge into a future state vision. From there, they will work closely with technical teams, including agentic AI capabilities, to build it. You will define where the client is today, articulate where they need to go, and own the future state narrative that anchors the transformation, not just configure the tool that gets them there.

Work you'll do

As a Life Science Senior Consultant, you will be responsible for the following.

•

Leading current state assessments and future state visioning for core Life Sciences commercial and medical processes such as Key Account Management, Speaker and Event Management, Field Coaching and Competency, Medical Interactions, and Sample Management, and articulating that journey to client stakeholders

•

Acting as the functional voice in the room. This means challenging legacy process assumptions, identifying where standardization should win over customization, and defining what "better" looks like before a single screen gets built

•

Partnering with solution architects and platform teams to translate future state process design into Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud capabilities, ensuring the build stays true to the business intent and not just the ticket

•

Identifying and scoping opportunities for agentic AI through Agentforce to augment or reimagine these processes. Examples include supporting KAM account planning, event follow up, or field coaching insights, along with defining the human in the loop model around it

•

Facilitating design workshops, process walkthroughs, and governance conversations with client business owners to convert domain expertise into build ready requirements

•

Developing business cases, future state process maps, and executive ready narratives that connect process transformation to measurable outcomes

•

Providing planning, design, and advisory support across the sales and medical technology lifecycle, from process design through requirements, configuration oversight, and adoption

•

Acting in a mentoring capacity to support the career development of colleagues, particularly in building functional to technical fluency

•

Supporting business development efforts, including Statements of Work, proposal development, and client presentations

•

Contributing to internal practice development including methodology, toolkits, training, and recruiting, with a focus on codifying process playbooks for Life Sciences commercial and medical functions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

•

Deep enough functional fluency in at least one Life Sciences business process domain, such as Events, Field Excellence, or Medical Affairs, to be the credible expert in the room with client business owners and not just the platform expert

•

Comfort operating at the intersection of business process and technology, including staying engaged through how a future state gets built and where AI or agentic capabilities fit

•

Ability to translate ambiguous business intent into structured, build ready detail

•

Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to run a room of client stakeholders through a future state conversation and land on decisions rather than just document opinions

•

Ability to lead workstreams independently while collaborating across cross functional technical and business teams

•

Executive level written and verbal communication, since this role regularly represents transformation vision to senior client stakeholders

•

Meticulous attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger operating model picture

•

Ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast paced, evolving environment

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences for life sciences organizations. We blend functional process expertise, technology, and creativity, with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud as our platform of choice and agentic AI as an increasingly central design lever, to help clients define where they're going and get there.

Qualifications

Required:

•

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

•

Minimum 3 years of professional experience in consulting or relevant Life Sciences industry roles, such as commercial operations, field operations, medical affairs, or sales operations

•

Demonstrated hands on ownership of at least one core Life Sciences business process, such as Key Account Management, Speaker or Event Management, Field Coaching, or Medical Interactions, either as a practitioner or as a consultant who led its redesign

•

Experience translating business process requirements into technology solutions. Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud experience is preferred, but equivalent CRM or commercial platform experience will be considered

•

Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve

•

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business need and applicable law.

Preferred

:

•

Salesforce Certified Agentforce for Life Sciences Consultant

•

Direct experience defining or scoping agentic AI use cases within a commercial or medical process, such as account planning, next best action, or case triage

•

2+ years of hands on experience configuring or advising on Life Sciences capabilities specifically, across personas such as Field Sales, KAM, MSLs, or Field Reimbursement Managers

•

Experience with adjacent Salesforce products such as Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, or MuleSoft based integrations

•

Experience delivering in a SAFe Agile environment at the Solution Train, ART, or scrum team level

Benefits At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute to their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our client most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.
