Description

Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in helping shape the future of movies and television? Do you want to help define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. On Prime Video, customers can customize their viewing experience and find their favourite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies Fallout, Heads of State, Reacher, Red One, Road House, The Accountant 2, The Boys, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, and The Summer I Turned Pretty; locally produced Originals such as The Girlfriend, Steal, Clarkson’s Farm, Molly-Mae: Behind it All, My Fault: London and Last One Laughing UK; licensed fan favorites such as Nine Perfect Strangers S2 and The Assassin; Prime member exclusive access to coverage of live sports including UEFA Champions League and NBA, and acclaimed sports documentaries. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

This is a uniquely dual-natured role that sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic vision. As Social Channels & Platforms Manager you will define the strategic direction for your assigned Social platforms, while being quick to adjust the operation of our social handles to optimize results. You will be the guardian of editorial plans, orchestrating with multiple stakeholder teams (titles, Brand, agencies) to ensure the best content is provided. You'll adjust quickly to results, be a first-adopter to new features and keep innovating on new handle opportunities, new editorial, platform and organic boosting tactics. You'll roll up your sleeves to solve tactical challenges when needed, and step back to develop strategies that elevate our social presence at scale. If you thrive in environments where no two days look the same, this role could be for you.

Key job responsibilities


 Manage day to day Prime Video social media handles, overseeing editorial plans and problem solving.
 Allocate organic boosting budgets optimally.
 Define the strategic approach to Social platforms.
 Be agile, shifting quickly to respond to performance signals, platform algorithm changes and new features.
 Orchestrate with internal teams to ensure the best content is provided for social handles.

 Partner with social platforms to identify new opportunities and develop innovative activations.
 Track, analyze and report results on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence.
 Unblock issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make recommendations for trade-offs, and meet delivery timelines.

About the team

Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and television series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video.

description:
About Manukora

Manukora is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency.




Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO."




Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations globally in the United States and Europe. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them.




We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories.




The role

We're bringing our paid ad creative in-house, and this is the hire that makes it happen. You'll be the dedicated designer for our paid team: statics and light motion for Meta, Amazon and our landing pages, briefed by our US-based creative strategists and built to one visual standard across brand and performance. You'll report to our Senior Design Lead for design craft, brand standards and development, and work with the strategists and paid creative team day to day.




This is a performance designer role, not a brand designer who happens to make ads. You've designed a lot of paid creative, you think in hooks, hierarchy and thumb-stop on a phone screen, and you're happy making 20 variants of a winner. You're brand-fluent enough to hold a premium standard: no meme ads, no two visual worlds.




We're open to two kinds of people:

A strong paid creative designer with real experience designing ads that ran, great craft and attention to detail, who knows what a good ad looks like and wants to keep growing.
A designer who's also a strategist: you go into the results, test ideas on purpose and want to know why version C beat version A.




What matters most in both cases is attitude. The people who've done best on our team are hungry, work really hard, adapt fast, care about every pixel and genuinely grow into the role.




What you'll do

Paid statics - design static ad concepts for Meta feed, TikTok, YouTube and other ad placements from creative strategist briefs, plus Amazon A+ content and landing page heroes
Light motion - bring statics to life with subtle animation: short, looping, ~5-second assets, not full video edits
Rapid iteration - most of the work is variants of what's already winning. Turn around fast, clean variant sets on new hooks, headlines, visuals and formats
Own the paid template system - build and maintain a documented static system (formats, sizes, brand-safe layouts, claim placements) that makes speed and consistency the default
Get it right on-canvas - apply our claims and compliance rules (MGO grades, product claims) and brand guidelines to every asset, every time
Read your own results - go into Motion, see how your ads performed, and work with the strategists on why - then design the next round off that
Deliver to spec and deadline - work through the production queue with the creative strategists, Creative Producer & Ops, and the growth/paid team
When there's capacity, support the wider design team on landing pages, retail and other digital assets




What you'll bring

3+ years designing paid social creative for US, UK or Australian DTC or CPG brands, in-house or at an agency, running high volumes of paid ads
A portfolio of ads that actually ran, ideally with results or context on what worked. A portfolio link is required, and it must include paid social ads that ran. Applications showing only brand, packaging or organic work will not be reviewed.
A strong understanding of how paid ads work - hooks, formats, placements, creative testing, and what moves the numbers
Excellent hierarchy, typography and layout instincts at thumbnail size
Fluency in Figma, plus After Effects or similar motion
Comfort with AI tools in the workflow (we use Higgsfield and CapCut) - used with judgement, never at the expense of craft
Speed without sloppiness - you can hit a volume target and still care about every pixel
A hunger to learn and grow, and the drive to do your best work every week
Brand-standard discipline - you respect a guideline and know how to push inside it

Sostener Asana como fuente de verdad del ciclo y Drive como repositorio del sistema — nada vive solo en la cabeza de una persona.

Correr los gates del mes: preps de Público, Comunidad y Dirección de Marca a tiempo, estrategias listas para validación antes de llegar al cliente, y cierre con retrabajo, incidentes y capacidad del mes siguiente.
Co-diseñar con el Performance Results Manager la metodología de crecimiento por tipo de cliente: PRM aporta el qué, tú lo conviertes en proceso.
Mantener el modelo de capacidad por rol y asignar cuentas con base en él, no en quién parece tener espacio.
Frenar o repriorizar la entrada de clientes cuando no hay capacidad financiada, con la decisión documentada.
Proponer al CEO las necesidades de contratación con datos de capacidad — tu modelo es el insumo del plan de reclutamiento.
Conducir la evaluación técnica y operativa de los candidatos a los roles de tu área.
Liderar de forma directa a Customer Success, Dirección de Marca y Comunidad Comercial: 1:1 mensuales, feedback y desarrollo conforme al plan de carrera.
Evaluar desempeño y periodos de prueba de tu área junto con HR.
Conducir el onboarding operativo de cada nuevo ingreso del área.
Exigir el ciclo a tiempo y desarrollar a tus CSPO — sin rehacer su estrategia por ellos.
Llevar una cuenta directa, para no perder contacto con la operación real del cliente.
Recibir los escalamientos operativos y de relación de los CSPO — que llegan con propuesta — y decidir el siguiente paso.
Dividir con PRM sin absorber: tú decides si hay capacidad y cómo corre el sistema; PRM decide si el resultado económico se sostiene.
Diseño de procesos, flujos o modelos de capacidad que tu equipo siguió usando sin depender de ti.
Gestión de carga y prioridades con datos: carga por persona, entregables a tiempo y retrabajo.
Documentación operativa: escribes procesos que otros ejecutan sin tener que preguntarte.
Lectura de performance (ROAS, CPA, CVR) suficiente para operar una cuenta y decidir prioridades o recursos con esos números.
Stack real: Asana como sistema del equipo, Slack, Google Workspace, Claude y AgencyAnalytics.
Corriges el proceso, no a la persona: cuando el ciclo se rompe, buscas el cuello de botella antes que al responsable.
Dices “no” con datos: frenas un cliente nuevo o una prioridad cuando la capacidad no da, y lo sostienes.
Conversaciones difíciles sin evadir: das feedback directo y le das seguimiento hasta que cambia el resultado.
Delegas sin absorber: cuando algo escala, defines qué hace cada rol en lugar de resolverlo tú solo.
4 años en agencia de marketing digital o medios, en operaciones, delivery o account management.
2 años liderando personas de forma directa: 1:1, feedback, evaluaciones y desarrollo.
Experiencia con varias cuentas en agencia, trato directo con clientes y manejo de escalamientos.
Modalidad híbrida con flexibilidad real.
Autoridad real sobre la operación: decides capacidad, asignaciones y cómo corre el ciclo mensual de toda la unidad de Performance.
Un equipo a tu cargo y un sistema en marcha para llevarlo al siguiente nivel — no arrancas de cero.
Contacto directo con el CEO y acceso a herramientas de punta, incluyendo IA aplicada a la operación.
Plan de carrera claro: Performance Operations Manager → Performance Operations Senior Manager conforme Startop escala.
Aplica en LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado.
Responde las preguntas filtro con honestidad — son parte del proceso.
Si hay match, HR te contacta en 72 horas para agendar el primer filtro.
El proceso incluye un caso práctico de capacidad y ciclo mensual, que presentarás antes de la entrevista final.
El proceso completo toma entre 3 y 4 semanas.

Ser dueño del sistema operativo, la capacidad y el equipo de Performance: que el ciclo mensual corra sin fricciones hacia adentro y hacia afuera, con capacidad sana y un equipo operando al 100% en sus roles.

Entras con título y honorarios de POM desde el día 1, y operas tus primeros 2 a 3 meses como Customer Success & Performance Operations Specialist con carga reducida para aprender ciclo, cuentas y equipo. Después asumes el rol con handoff formal. 

A 90 días de asumirlo: capacidad promedio del equipo ≤ 85% y 100% de estrategias y entregables del ciclo a tiempo.




LO QUE HARÁS




Sistema operativo:

Mapear y mantener el ciclo mensual de Performance semana a semana: qué proceso corre, quién participa, con qué herramienta y qué entregable sale.
Documentar la operación diaria por rol (Customer Success, Dirección de Marca, Comunidad Comercial, Público Comercial) y las metodologías por tipo de cliente: onboarding, integración de plataformas y CRM.
Sostener Asana como fuente de verdad del ciclo y Drive como repositorio del sistema — nada vive solo en la cabeza de una persona.
Correr los gates del mes: preps de Público, Comunidad y Dirección de Marca a tiempo, estrategias listas para validación antes de llegar al cliente, y cierre con retrabajo, incidentes y capacidad del mes siguiente.
Co-diseñar con el Performance Results Manager la metodología de crecimiento por tipo de cliente: PRM aporta el qué, tú lo conviertes en proceso.

Capacidad y headcount:

Mantener el modelo de capacidad por rol y asignar cuentas con base en él, no en quién parece tener espacio.
Frenar o repriorizar la entrada de clientes cuando no hay capacidad financiada, con la decisión documentada.
Proponer al CEO las necesidades de contratación con datos de capacidad — tu modelo es el insumo del plan de reclutamiento.
Conducir la evaluación técnica y operativa de los candidatos a los roles de tu área.

Personas:

Liderar de forma directa a Customer Success, Dirección de Marca y Comunidad Comercial: 1:1 mensuales, feedback y desarrollo conforme al plan de carrera.
Evaluar desempeño y periodos de prueba de tu área junto con HR.
Conducir el onboarding operativo de cada nuevo ingreso del área.
Exigir el ciclo a tiempo y desarrollar a tus CSPO — sin rehacer su estrategia por ellos.

Cuenta propia y escalamientos:

Llevar una cuenta directa, para no perder contacto con la operación real del cliente.
Recibir los escalamientos operativos y de relación de los CSPO — que llegan con propuesta — y decidir el siguiente paso.
Dividir con PRM sin absorber: tú decides si hay capacidad y cómo corre el sistema; PRM decide si el resultado económico se sostiene.




EL PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS




Hard skills — lo que debes saber hacer:

Diseño de procesos, flujos o modelos de capacidad que tu equipo siguió usando sin depender de ti.
Gestión de carga y prioridades con datos: carga por persona, entregables a tiempo y retrabajo.
Documentación operativa: escribes procesos que otros ejecutan sin tener que preguntarte.
Lectura de performance (ROAS, CPA, CVR) suficiente para operar una cuenta y decidir prioridades o recursos con esos números.
Stack real: Asana como sistema del equipo, Slack, Google Workspace, Claude y AgencyAnalytics.

Soft skills — cómo debes operar:

Corriges el proceso, no a la persona: cuando el ciclo se rompe, buscas el cuello de botella antes que al responsable.
Dices “no” con datos: frenas un cliente nuevo o una prioridad cuando la capacidad no da, y lo sostienes.
Conversaciones difíciles sin evadir: das feedback directo y le das seguimiento hasta que cambia el resultado.
Delegas sin absorber: cuando algo escala, defines qué hace cada rol en lugar de resolverlo tú solo.

Experiencia:

4 años en agencia de marketing digital o medios, en operaciones, delivery o account management.
2 años liderando personas de forma directa: 1:1, feedback, evaluaciones y desarrollo.
Experiencia con varias cuentas en agencia, trato directo con clientes y manejo de escalamientos.




LO QUE OFRECEMOS




Modalidad híbrida con flexibilidad real.
Autoridad real sobre la operación: decides capacidad, asignaciones y cómo corre el ciclo mensual de toda la unidad de Performance.
Un equipo a tu cargo y un sistema en marcha para llevarlo al siguiente nivel — no arrancas de cero.
Contacto directo con el CEO y acceso a herramientas de punta, incluyendo IA aplicada a la operación.
Plan de carrera claro: Performance Operations Manager → Performance Operations Senior Manager conforme Startop escala.




¿ERES TÚ?




Si cumples con el perfil y estás listo para aplicar, este es el proceso:

Aplica en LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado.
Responde las preguntas filtro con honestidad — son parte del proceso.
Si hay match, HR te contacta en 72 horas para agendar el primer filtro.
El proceso incluye un caso práctico de capacidad y ciclo mensual, que presentarás antes de la entrevista final.
El proceso completo toma entre 3 y 4 semanas.

title: GH&B Portfolio Management Lead (LATAM)
skills: Global Hospital & Biosimilars (GH&B) makes the products that are the foundation of hospital care — sterile injectables and biosimilars – that reach more than 100 million patients annually, generating $5 billion in revenue for Pfizer. These are not niche products; they are for when patients are at the most vulnerable, essential to access and acute care delivery worldwide.

GH&B is Pfizer's only truly end-to-end business, spanning from our 12 global manufacturing sites through to commercial in a single integrated organization. It was created to give this portfolio dedicated focus, clearer accountability, and a fit-for-purpose operating model — recognizing that GH&B's portfolio has different economics, customer dynamics, and execution needs than Pfizer's innovative business.
By bringing Commercial and Supply into one organization, GH&B enables faster decision-making, stronger prioritization, and expanded capabilities for this important portfolio.
Our ambition: Rebuild a healthy operation positioned to serve patients for generations to come.

The Portfolio Management Lead is the strategic owner of the cluster's product portfolio across biosimilars and generics (Oncology, Immunology/Inflammation), responsible for driving portfolio prioritization, go-to-market design, launch sequencing, and lifecycle optimization across all cluster markets. The role translates global portfolio strategy into cluster-specific execution plans, ensuring the right products reach the right markets at the right time -- balancing growth ambition with resource constraints and competitive realities.

This is a build-and-shape role: the Portfolio Management Lead will establish portfolio governance and decision-making frameworks from the ground up, identify white-space growth opportunities, and orchestrate cross-functional launch readiness in a newly formed cluster operating model.
Portfolio Strategy & Prioritization
Own the cluster portfolio strategy across biosimilars and generics; prioritize products by market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and margin contribution
Translate global portfolio and lifecycle decisions into cluster-specific roadmaps, calibrating to local market realities (regulatory timelines, competitive landscapes, payer requirements)
Conduct portfolio gap analysis and white-space identification to inform growth opportunities and in-licensing/expansion discussions with Global
Manage portfolio rationalization decisions – recommend product additions, withdrawals, or re-sequencing based on evolving market intelligence
Design go-to-market approaches tailored to cluster archetypes -- adapting to contract-driven, tender-driven, or partner/distributor-led environments
Define the commercial model per product and market: channel mix, customer targeting (hospital pharmacy, tender bodies, payers, wholesalers), and the resourcing required to execute

Drive launch readiness and launch sequencing for new product introductions, coordinating cross-functional workstreams (Medical, Regulatory, Supply, Market Access, Tenders & Contracting) and optimizing timing against competitive windows, supply availability, and market access milestones
Identify and develop growth opportunities through portfolio expansion, geographic extension, and new indication pull-through
Assess and recommend entry strategies for underpenetrated markets within the cluster
Collaborate with Global Portfolio Strategy on pipeline visibility and early commercial input for assets relevant to the cluster
Lead business case development for portfolio investments, working with Finance and Commercial Performance to model revenue scenarios
Decide which portfolio assets are best commercialized through partners or distributors versus direct Pfizer execution, and recommend the partnering model by asset and market
Drive partner selection process: define selection criteria, lead evaluation and due diligence, and recommend commercial terms for Cluster Lead approval (incl. Legal, Finance, and Compliance)
Own the ongoing partner relationship – joint business planning, target setting, and volume and stock commitments — working within the SLA and governance parameters set at the cluster level
Track partner performance against agreed targets and re-assess, renegotiate, or exit arrangements where performance, compliance, or shifting portfolio priorities require it

Serve as the primary commercial interface to PGS/Supply Chain for demand planning, allocation and prioritization decisions, stock-out risk mitigation, and product availability commitments across the cluster, in partnership with Global
Translate commercial forecasts and launch plans into supply requirements; escalate and manage supply constraint trade-offs across markets
Leverage the technical supply forecasts and analytics produced by the Commercial Performance to inform commercial demand planning, improve forecast accuracy, and flag constraint risk earlier
Establish and lead portfolio governance forums within the cluster -- including regular portfolio reviews, launch readiness gates, and lifecycle decision checkpoints
Coordinate with Pricing, Market Access, and Tenders & Contracting to ensure portfolio decisions are reflected in pricing corridors, tender strategies, and formulary submissions
Partner with Marketing on brand positioning and clinical education strategy for priority portfolio assets
Collaborate with the Commercial Performance Manager to ensure portfolio KPIs, revenue tracking, and competitive intelligence feed back into portfolio decisions
Champion adoption of AI-enabled ways of working and foster a culture of data-driven portfolio decision-making
Leverage technology, data, and AI-driven insights to inform portfolio strategy, accelerate launch readiness, and improve demand forecasting accuracy
Demonstrate strong personal digital literacy and AI fluency, modelling practical use of data, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions
Identify and scale opportunities for automation and simplification in portfolio management processes
Ensure responsible use of AI through appropriate governance, risk awareness, and human oversight

Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and clinical education strategies for priority portfolio assets – KOL mapping, congress presence, and conversion programming to support biosimilar switching and new product adoption among target HCPs and hospital pharmacists
Lead market development planning for growth brands, identifying patient pools, referral pathways, and demand-generation levers across cluster markets

Own promotional activity for select brands — campaign development, materials creation, and channel strategy – adapting global brand positioning and channel standards (digital, peer-to-peer, field-led) to local market needs, leveraging AI-enabled scientific content where available

Coordinate with Medical Affairs on compliant scientific engagement, ensure alignment with local regulatory requirements, and monitor brand performance to adjust marketing investment against competitive dynamics and uptake
Bachelor's degree required in Life Sciences, Business, or related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred
6+ years of experience in portfolio management, brand/product management, or commercial strategy within healthcare/pharma
Demonstrated experience managing multi-product portfolios across multiple markets, including launch planning and lifecycle optimization
Significant experience in biosimilars, generics, or established brands required
Strong strategic thinking with proven ability to translate global strategy into market-level execution
Experience with demand planning, supply interfaces, and cross-functional launch coordination
Fluency in English required; additional cluster language an asset
Digital literacy, including practical experience leveraging data and analytics tools for portfolio decisions
Master's degree with relevant pharmaceutical industry experience
Experience in biosimilar market development, including tender and contract-driven environments
Track record of successful product launches in multi-market or cluster-based operating models
Leadership experience in one or more of the respective cluster markets
Transformation experience, particularly in building new capabilities or operating models
Experience managing distributor/partner-led portfolio execution
Strong negotiation and influencing skills across matrix organizations

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Partner Marketing Manager at Canonical

Canonical is looking for a channel marketing manager who will be responsible for developing our strategic relationships with a set of global partners . Canonical partners with the leading companies in technology across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle…), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx…), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). As our business increasingly depends on partners, the scope of our partnership grows every year (GSI, software vendors, IoT…). We are thus looking for an individual, who will not only drive successful marketing activities with our partners but also shape our partner programs.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Marketing.

Location:This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

What your day will look like


Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, from messaging to pipeline generation
Create and deliver integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content in collaboration with partners.
Package all of Canonical's product offerings and educational material creatively, from bare metal, AI, Kubernetes...
Continue to grow Canonical's partner ecosystem by delivering partner value
Continue to develop Canonical's partner activities to scale our partner programs



What we are looking for in you


Experience in B2B marketing and experience working with strategic corporate partners to develop co-marketing initiatives. 
Strong customer/partner relationship management skills.
Proven analytical skills, able to assess opportunities and make decisions on ROI/advantages of programs & investments.
Willingness to roll up their sleeves.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.



Nice-to-have Skills


Experience in enterprise software, SaaS or silicon preferred
Track record of delivering strong results and innovation.
Ability to work and thrive in a self-starter, fast-paced and changing environment
Love for diverse work assignments and the opportunity to try new approaches
Growth mindset - someone who is not afraid to think big and take on risk.



What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Sostener Asana como fuente de verdad del ciclo y Drive como repositorio del sistema — nada vive solo en la cabeza de una persona.

Correr los gates del mes: preps de Público, Comunidad y Dirección de Marca a tiempo, estrategias listas para validación antes de llegar al cliente, y cierre con retrabajo, incidentes y capacidad del mes siguiente.
Co-diseñar con el Performance Results Manager la metodología de crecimiento por tipo de cliente: PRM aporta el qué, tú lo conviertes en proceso.
Mantener el modelo de capacidad por rol y asignar cuentas con base en él, no en quién parece tener espacio.
Frenar o repriorizar la entrada de clientes cuando no hay capacidad financiada, con la decisión documentada.
Proponer al CEO las necesidades de contratación con datos de capacidad — tu modelo es el insumo del plan de reclutamiento.
Conducir la evaluación técnica y operativa de los candidatos a los roles de tu área.
Liderar de forma directa a Customer Success, Dirección de Marca y Comunidad Comercial: 1:1 mensuales, feedback y desarrollo conforme al plan de carrera.
Evaluar desempeño y periodos de prueba de tu área junto con HR.
Conducir el onboarding operativo de cada nuevo ingreso del área.
Exigir el ciclo a tiempo y desarrollar a tus CSPO — sin rehacer su estrategia por ellos.
Llevar una cuenta directa, para no perder contacto con la operación real del cliente.
Recibir los escalamientos operativos y de relación de los CSPO — que llegan con propuesta — y decidir el siguiente paso.
Dividir con PRM sin absorber: tú decides si hay capacidad y cómo corre el sistema; PRM decide si el resultado económico se sostiene.
Diseño de procesos, flujos o modelos de capacidad que tu equipo siguió usando sin depender de ti.
Gestión de carga y prioridades con datos: carga por persona, entregables a tiempo y retrabajo.
Documentación operativa: escribes procesos que otros ejecutan sin tener que preguntarte.
Lectura de performance (ROAS, CPA, CVR) suficiente para operar una cuenta y decidir prioridades o recursos con esos números.

This is a hands-on operations role. You'll work side by side with our growth team, take a large share of the day-to-day execution off their plates, and then make the whole machine faster, using AI tools and smart systems so that what took a day last month takes an hour this month.

You need to be relentlessly organized, fast, scrappy, and energized by getting things done.

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

We care more about how you work than where you've worked. Great fits might come from events and program coordination, executive assistance, startup operations, partnerships, teaching, or any role where staying organized under pressure was the job.

Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance.  

Responsibilities: 
- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth.  
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making.  
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities.  
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance.  
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans.  
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators.  
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others.  
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude.  
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions.  
 
Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in operations or partner management
- Able to establish contact, build up trust with creators, and provide complete support on platform training, creator engagement activities.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

description:
Responsibilities
The authenticity of TikTok has created a new way for brands and partners to meaningfully connect with creators and the community. Through an innovative E-commerce platform that helps discover and purchase products within the app, TikTok E-commerce enhances promotion and sales for partners and brands with an entertaining user experience.

Are you passionate about revolutionizing the E-commerce experience? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where creativity meets strategy? Join our TikTok Shop Partnership (TSP) team as we shape the future of social E-commerce. The team is in charge of managing Partners - agencies who service brands on TikTok and responsible for partners' performance.

We are looking for an account manager to onboard, incubate and support Partners in the Mexico market. As the Partnership Development and Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in expanding and driving the TSP ecosystem.

The role Partnership Development and Operations Manager is to expand and drive the TSP ecosystem through business development, training and project management. This position sits cross-functionally, working closely with stakeholders from different business units and external parties to support in matchmaking TSPs with partners on the platform. This candidate will take part in onboarding and education of partners, from smaller TikTok savvy agencies to media companies. You will become an expert on social E-commerce and all things to support our partners and help them to onboard their clients and grow sales on the platform. The position requires data analysis of various metrics, from livestreams and short videos, to identify opportunities to help TSPs support sellers to succeed on TikTok.

Responsibilities:
- Establish TikTok as the E-commerce platform of choice for brands by building strong relationships and exploring partnership opportunities with E-commerce and digital marketing agencies across core functions including: creative, social, production, logistics and influencer marketing.
- Establish themselves as the primary liaison, TikTok advocate and owner of client relationships for their respective agencies.
- Support partners throughout their onboarding and incubation on the platform, including identifying opportunities, providing strategic briefs, training, and consultation.

description:
PRÁCTICAS PROFESIONALES Y SERVICIO SOCIAL | COMUNICACIÓN




CADICZA

Departamento · Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas

Modalidad de incorporación · Prácticas profesionales o servicio social.

Modalidad · En línea

País · México

Plazas disponibles · 3




1. DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DE LA POSICIÓN




CADICZA, despacho de arquitectura especializado en diseño residencial de lujo, busca integrar estudiantes al área de Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas para fortalecer la presencia pública de la marca, establecer vínculos con medios de comunicación y apoyar la difusión de proyectos e iniciativas del despacho.




La convocatoria está dirigida a estudiantes de Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o carreras afines que quieran adquirir experiencia en comunicación de marca, gestión de prensa y planificación de lanzamientos.




2. ACTIVIDADES Y RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA




* Apoyar en la gestión de la marca CADICZA desde el área de relaciones públicas, cuidando la coherencia de sus mensajes y su presentación ante públicos externos.

* Investigar y actualizar el directorio de medios, periodistas y editores de arquitectura, diseño, cultura e interés general.

* Preparar mensajes de acercamiento y dar seguimiento a propuestas de cobertura, entrevistas y colaboraciones con medios.

* Redactar y editar comunicados de prensa, fichas informativas y materiales para la difusión de proyectos.

* Apoyar en la planificación de lanzamientos de proyectos e iniciativas, organizando calendarios, materiales y fechas de difusión.

* Registrar contactos, respuestas y publicaciones para dar seguimiento a los resultados de cada acción de comunicación.




3. REQUISITOS




Escolaridad




* Cursar Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o una carrera afín.

* Estudiar en una institución educativa en México y reunir los requisitos académicos para iniciar prácticas profesionales o servicio social.




Aptitudes




* Buena redacción, ortografía y capacidad para adaptar el tono a distintos públicos.

* Organización para dar seguimiento a contactos, tareas y fechas de entrega.

* Criterio para identificar medios y oportunidades de difusión relevantes para cada proyecto.

* Iniciativa, atención al detalle y disposición para colaborar a distancia.




Software y herramientas




* Manejo de correo electrónico y herramientas de trabajo en línea como Google Docs, Sheets y Drive.

* Se valorará la experiencia con herramientas de planificación editorial, monitoreo de medios o diseño de presentaciones.




Otros




* Residir en México y contar con disponibilidad para cumplir las horas acordadas en modalidad remota.

* Tener interés en la comunicación aplicada a la arquitectura, el diseño o la cultura.




4. BENEFICIOS




Esquema de participación




Prácticas profesionales o servicio social sin remuneracion. La acreditación de horas está sujeta a la autorización de la institución educativa y a la formalización de los documentos correspondientes.




Desarrollo profesional en CADICZA




* Experiencia práctica en relaciones públicas, gestión de prensa y comunicación de marca dentro de un despacho de arquitectura.

* Participación en la preparación y difusión de lanzamientos, desde la definición del mensaje hasta el seguimiento de la cobertura.

* Retroalimentación sobre textos, propuestas de difusión y materiales de comunicación.

* Créditos de colaboración cuando corresponda, acceso a la bolsa de trabajo y acceso a los beneficios de salud disponibles, conforme a sus condiciones.




5. FORMATO DE POSTULACIÓN




Envía tu CV mediante la opción de postulación de LinkedIn o al correo vinculacion@cadicza.com

description:
Acerca del rol




Coordinador/a Incubadora Centros de Negocio




En este rol serás responsable de coordinar con la comunidad interna y externa la creación de empresas rentables, mediante un esquema de asesoría y mentoría alineado al proceso institucional de incubación. Impulsarás el desarrollo, formalización y puesta en marcha de microempresas, promoviendo la cultura del emprendimiento y generando impacto en la formación práctica de nuestros estudiantes, el fortalecimiento del ecosistema empresarial y el cumplimiento de metas de ingreso y participación institucional.




Tus principales retos




• Coordinar actividades de difusión de cultura emprendedora (ferias, bazares y conferencias) para fortalecer el posicionamiento de la incubadora en campus y comunidad externa.

• Organizar e impartir talleres de emprendimiento que faciliten la estructuración y validación de ideas de negocio.

• Asesorar proyectos en el desarrollo integral del plan de negocio, asegurando su correcta presentación ante comité y seguimiento en el proceso de incubación.

• Evaluar y entrevistar ideas de negocio para identificar proyectos viables y con potencial de rentabilidad.

• Gestionar inscripciones, pagos y seguimiento administrativo de proyectos para garantizar el cumplimiento del proceso institucional.

• Coordinar la participación de emprendedores en concursos internos y externos, alineando postulaciones a convocatorias vigentes.

• Elaborar y presentar informes mensuales de resultados ante directivos, impulsando estrategias para el logro de metas de ingresos y participación.

• Representar a la incubadora en eventos externos, fortaleciendo alianzas institucionales y promoviendo los servicios del centro de negocio.




Perfil que buscamos

Requisitos indispensables:




• Licenciatura en áreas Económico-Administrativas. (Título y cédula).

• 2 a 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo e implementación de planes de negocio, incubación o ejecución de proyectos empresariales, (proyectos a nivel académico)

• Conocimientos sólidos en elaboración de planes de negocio, metodologías ágiles, innovación y paquetería Office avanzada.

• Experiencia en coordinación de actividades académicas o empresariales.

• Inglés intermedio.




Deseables:

• Maestría en Desarrollo de Negocios, Innovación, Sistemas Industriales o MBA.

• Experiencia en entornos educativos o ecosistemas de emprendimiento.

• Competencias clave: pensamiento estratégico, liderazgo colaborativo, comunicación asertiva, orientación a resultados, gestión del tiempo, innovación y resolución de problemas.




Vivir en la CDMX en el sur de la Ciudad (alcaldía Coyoacán)




Tu impacto en UVM




En la Universidad del Valle de México formamos personas íntegras para una vida plena y un mundo mejor.

Tu rol será parte esencial de esa transformación, contribuyendo a fortalecer la cultura emprendedora y formando líderes capaces de crear empresas con impacto social y económico. Aquí no solo encontrarás un empleo, sino la oportunidad de trabajar con sentido, transformando vidas a través de la educación y siendo parte de una institución con más de 60 años de historia y presencia nacional.
